name: Client ROI Report

parameters.content: This workflow runs every 30 days, computing trailing-30-day metrics from Leads, Appointments, and Communication Log (new leads, missed-call recoveries, appointments booked/kept), and emails the client an outcome-framed recap. Email is sent by default; SMS is built but off by default - both toggled, along with the recipient address/number, via the CONFIG block at the top of 'Build ROI Report'.

description: Every 30 days, emails the client a trailing-30-day outcome recap (new leads, missed-call recoveries, appointments booked/kept). Email default ON, SMS built but OFF - recipient and toggles set via CONFIG block in 'Build ROI Report'.
